We were expecting the supplier portal invite this morning but none of our finance team members received it. Our security team pulled the delivery logs and it looks like messages from your invites domain are being quarantined by Gmail/Workspace under DMARC (quarantine). We can see a header rewrite and the message is flagged as: "Authentication-Results: dmarc=quarantine (policy=quarantine)".

I've attached a screenshot of the Gmail quarantine notice and an anonymized copy of the SMTP headers. Can you either resend from a different sender or provide a manual activation link that we can use? We're trying to get purchase order (PO) setup started — vendor onboarding is blocking our first PO for this quarter.

Also, is there any special PO metadata you need from us (tax id, remit address, W9)? Julien can attach documents once we have a working invite method.

Thanks,
Samira

Hi Samira — Rachel here from Onboarding. Appreciate the headers and screenshot; helpful signal. A few notes from our side: we reviewed the SMTP headers you shared. The quarantine looks to be happening because your inbound gateway (or Gmail's heuristic) is seeing DKIM alignment mismatch after an intermediate rewrite. That's triggering DMARC quarantine under your org policy.

Workarounds we can perform immediately:
1) Create a short-lived manual activation URL and deliver it to an alternate recipient you provide. The link will bypass the normal invite flow (we'll still log acceptance and tie to the Cypressware account). Expires in 48 hours by default, can extend if needed.
2) Resend the invite from support@redwood-inference.com and add a reply-to to the Ben/Onboarding group.
3) If your security team can whitelist mail-from/redwood DKIM domain and/or allowlist our sending IP range, that will stop the quarantine for future messages.

PO onboarding checklist (so you can attach everything at once):
- Company legal name
- W9 (US) or local tax document
- Remit address and invoicing email
- Purchase order contact & email
- Any payment-terms exceptions (net30, net45, etc)

Please attach the W9 and preferred recipient for the manual link. We'll also include the temporary activation link in the HubSpot deal (see link below) so your procurement team has a record.
